description: This file defines classes and functions related to device management and stream handling in the PyTorch accelerator namespace, including DeviceGuard and Stream classes, with functions to get current device and stream.

classes.name: DeviceGuard
classes.description: RAII class that manages device context, setting the device on construction and restoring previous on destruction.

classes.name: Stream
classes.description: Represents a stream object with an associated stream ID, constructed from a stream handle.

methods.name: DeviceGuard
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the device guard with a specific device index.

methods.name: set_index
methods.description: Changes the current device to the specified device index.

methods.name: Stream
methods.description: Constructor that creates a Stream object from a stream handle, taking ownership.

methods.name: id
methods.description: Returns the stream ID associated with the Stream object.

methods.name: getCurrentStream
methods.description: Returns the current stream for a given device index.

methods.name: getCurrentDeviceIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of the currently active device.
